design: Source-grounded repair on the already fixed development recordings; not an independent clinical or blind test
scope: Separate epoch output label from physiological end context
R.1 precedence over N2.4 arousal path
fixed: all detectors including the known 4Hz overlap
original primary and full-record evaluation masks

segment_conventions.majority: strictly greater than 15 seconds of the fixed 30-second epoch; UNKNOWN seconds never removed from denominator
segment_conventions.arousal_interval: UNKNOWN segment; does not count toward either N1 or N2. This is an explicit conservative engineering convention, not verified verbatim AASM v2.4 text
segment_conventions.post_arousal_N1: Only actual LAMF-covered time after arousal offset and before a new qualifying K/spindle; interruptions retained across epochs even when output label remains N2
segment_conventions.N2_before_arousal: Preserve an existing N2 context up to onset; a qualifying first-half N2 event retains the frozen onset rule where no intervening arousal occurs
segment_conventions.reentry: A new qualifying K or spindle at or after the active arousal offset changes end context to N2 at its onset; K-associated arousal list must be empty; no epoch-wide arousal veto
segment_conventions.carry_anchor: An event in the frozen previous-last-15-seconds onset window initializes current physiological N2 context only if the window is valid and no intervening/overlapping arousal invalidated it
segment_conventions.R3_N2_label: Preserve R.3.N2 epoch-label priority, but retain any later N2-arousal termination in the independent end context
segment_conventions.multiple_arousals: chronological processing; every new arousal after an N2 anchor invalidates that anchor; later structure may reenter again
segment_conventions.exact_tie_or_insufficient: No new temporal-majority rule. Continue original remaining rules then unchanged fallback; never use fallback output to resurrect invalid physiological N2 context
segment_conventions.end_context: Physiological state survives separately from label; UNKNOWN LAMF gaps do not constitute validated clinical negatives
segment_conventions.scope_limit: Segment engine addresses N2-arousal episodes only; does not redesign general N1, REM termination, MBM, N3 or Wake scoring

priority: Keep original N3/W, R.3 and movement semantics. R.1 precedes N2 arousal segment assignment. Unrelated N1/N2 continuation predicates remain frozen.
fallback: INHERIT_PREVIOUS, unchanged and unbounded, using the previous output label, not end context
validation_sequence: real EDF replay of all ten fixed development recordings
development-only evaluation and paired trace analysis
label_policy: No final-evaluation record annotations read. Implementation frozen before new development metrics. No accuracy-dependent threshold or policy selection.
comparators: frozen V1 on same development IDs
frozen V3 on same development IDs
metrics: label lineage and physiological arousal-context propagation

bootstrap.interpretation: exploratory uncertainty on only ten reused development records

waveform_cases: Keep the previous audit's nine development cases; compare exact same epoch IDs and chain C06, no outcome-dependent case selection
